high_level_description: A digital logo for Webkeeper on a black background, featuring a stylized 3D hexagonal emblem with white and green geometric shapes and the text 'WEBKEEPER' in a bold, sans-serif font with a green-to-white gradient. Below the main text, the Portuguese phrase 'ECOSSISTEMAS DE IAS PARA NEGÓCIOS' is written in white, flanked by two green horizontal lines with circular endcaps.

elements.desc: A large, stylized 3D hexagonal logo on the left side. It features a geometric, crystalline structure with sharp facets. The left half is rendered in a bright, metallic white with subtle gray shading, while the right half is a vibrant, glossy lime green. The logo is framed by a thin, glowing green outline and small, circular green nodes connected by thin lines, suggesting a digital or networked theme.

Headline-sized text positioned horizontally in the center-right. The font is a bold, modern sans-serif. The letters 'WEB' are solid white, while 'KEEPER' features a vibrant green-to-yellow gradient. The 'E' in 'WEB' is stylized with a horizontal line through its center.
